_note: Each recipient MUST be a Stripe Connected Account before receiving transfers. charges_enabled_verified=false until the user manually verifies through the dashboard. The monthly cron skips entries with charges_enabled_verified=false and emits a 🚨 to Slack. Most US charities are NOT on Stripe Connect — they need to onboard with us as a connected account before this rail works. For charities that won't onboard, set rail='agent-{{profile.lateness.stakeholders.channel}}' and the routing will fall through to ~/.openclaw/skills/donation-v2-archive/.
